decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:E00, E01, E02, E03 and E04, P00, P01, P02, P03, P04, P05, P06, P07, Highways Safety Impact Assessment, SuDS pro forma and CIL form.Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

Above ground works shall not commence until details of source control SuDS have been submitted and approved by the Local Authority. Source control SuDS measures include green roofs, rain gardens and permeable paving. The details must include plans, specifications and maintenance information. The developer should use the SuDS Proforma for minor developers found on our webpage https://www.enfield.gov.uk/services/planning/sustainable-drainage-systems to assist them through our requirementsREASON: To ensure the sustainable management of water, minimise flood risk, minimise discharge of surface water outside of the curtilage of the property and ensure that the drainage system will remain functional throughout the lifetime of the development in accordance with Policy CP28 of the Core Strategy, DMD Policy 61, and Policies SI12 & SI13 of the London Plan and the NPPF and to maximise opportunities for sustainable development, improve water quality, biodiversity, local amenity and recreation value

The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until details of the 7 long-stay/short-stay cycle parking spaces have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. These details should demonstrate: Location :Near entrances or main access Design: Stands or wall bars Security: Secure, overlooked, well-lit Coverage: Covered where possible Accessibility: Step-free, no obstructions The cycle parking spaces shall be fully constructed in accordance with the approved details prior to first occupation and shall thereafter be retained for the lifetime of the development. Reason: To ensure that adequate cycle parking facilities are provided to promote sustainable modes of transport.

The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until the first floor side elevation window serving ensuite to bedroom 6 drawing P02) , if retained, has been fitted with obscured glazing, and no part of those windows less than 1.7 metres above the floor of the room in which they are installed shall be capable of being opened. Details of the type of obscured glazing shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority before the window is installed and once installed the obscured glazing shall be retained thereafter.Reason: To ensure that the future occupation of the building protect privacy and does not adversely affect neighbours

The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied by more than seven residents at any one time without first obtaining the approval, in writing, of the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To ensure that the future occupation of the building does not adversely affect neighbours

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture as specified in the approved application.Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.

No cooking facilities, including hot plates, shall be installed in the bedrooms of the development hereby permitted unless details have first been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Any cooking facilities shall thereafter only be implemented in accordance with the details that have been approved pursuant to this condition.Reason: To accord with the stipulations of definition as a House of Multiple Occupation and to safeguard the residential character of the surrounding area.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended), the existing living room door shown on the front elevation of the approved plans shall be retained in perpetuity and shall not be replaced by a window or other opening unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.Reason: To ensure the retention of direct access to the external amenity area
description: Change of use from Use Class C3 (dwelling house) to a Class Sui Generis (HMO - house in multiple occupation) with associated cycle and refuse storage involving single storey rear extension and rear dormer with front rooflights.
